info.title: mcpindex.ai public API
info.description: Public read API for mcpindex.ai, the drift-monitored MCP server index with an advisory trust screen. Verdicts are advisory (REVIEW when screened, else UNVERIFIED fail-closed; ALLOW/DENY reserved, not produced) - a contract screen, not a safety guarantee. No authentication required. A hosted remote MCP endpoint with the same capabilities is at https://mcpindex.ai/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP).

get.summary: Public drift ledger: contract changes the crawler observed, paged
get.description: Contract diffs listed by fingerprint (keyed hashes of public registry names under a published key; recomputable, not anonymous) - a contract-diff record, not a safety verdict. Schema mcpindex.drift.ledger/4. One section per request: events (tool contract changes), context_events (server instructions and prompt metadata) or fleet_events (publisher-wide changes, counted once). When ledger_schema is mcpindex.drift.ledger/3, events omits tools whose only change was part of a publisher-wide change; look those up with /api/v1/drift/any. events and context_events pages hold up to 1,000 rows, newest first; fleet_events pages are packed by size. With no parameters this returns page 0 of events. To read a whole section, request ?section=<name> and follow next_cursor until it is null. A cursor stays in the generation it was issued for, so every page of one walk comes from the same hourly publish; a superseded generation stays readable for at least an hour after the next publish, then its cursors answer 410. The /3 single-response dump is retired.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Which list to page through. With a cursor it may be omitted; a value that differs from the cursor's section is 400.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque. Pass next_cursor from the previous page exactly as returned. A malformed cursor is 400.

generated_at.description: When the latest index was published. The same on every page.

generation.description: The generation the items belong to. A cursor keeps it, so every page of one walk carries the same value.

ledger_schema.description: The row semantics the drain built. Under /3, publisher-wide changes are counted once in fleet_events.

stat.description: Headline counts from the latest published generation.

counts.description: Row counts from the latest published generation.

pages.description: Page count for this section in this generation.

items.description: Rows of the requested section, validated: malformed event and context rows are dropped and free fields bounded, so a page can hold fewer rows than counts suggests.

next_cursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= for the next page; null on the last page.

410.description: cursor_expired: that generation's pages are gone. restart is the path that starts the section again.

503.description: The ledger is not published right now (missing, stale or malformed). No rows are served.

get.summary: What changed in the registry since a date

200.description: Registry changes since the date. counts.added and added[] are server names first seen at or after the date; counts.updated and updated[] are servers first seen before it whose latest version was published, or whose record was updated, at or after it. First-seen dates are the earliest publishedAt across the registry snapshots mcpindex has kept since 2026-05-01; a window starting before that carries the provenance limit since_precedes_first_seen_history.

get.summary: Fleet drift query: has this tool contract drifted (crawler-corroborated)?

parameters.name: fp
parameters.description: Tool contract fingerprint: 32 lowercase hex characters.

200.description: drifted:true carries the corroboration fields. drifted:false carries nothing else. drifted:null means the drift cache was unavailable: unknown, not clean.

sources.description: Independent sources that corroborate the drift; 1 is the crawler alone.

post.summary: Batch fleet drift query for multiple fingerprints

200.description: Per-fingerprint drift results, one per distinct fingerprint, each shaped like the GET response.
